title: Kazuda Xiono
subtitle: Best Pilot in the Galaxy
text: Action [Exhaust]: A friendly unit loses all abilities for this round. Take an extra action after this one.
deployBox:
On Attack: Choose any number of friendly units. They lose all abilities for this round.
Attached unit is a leader unit. It gains: “On Attack: Choose any number of friendly units. They lose all abilities for this round.”
epicAction:
Epic Action: If you control 4 or more resources, choose one:
Deploy this leader.
Deploy this leader as an upgrade on a friendly Vehicle unit without a Pilot on it.
rules:
You may take any standard action as your extra action: Play a Card, Attack With a Unit, Use an Action Ability, Take the Initiative, or Pass.
The chosen units for Kaz's “On Attack” ability lose all abilities for the round even if he is defeated.
A friendly unit that has lost all abilities for the round cannot gain or be given any new abilities for the round.
